name: YeeSubscriptions – Subscription Plans for WooCommerce
author: add-ons.org

sections.description:
YeeSubscriptions is a lightweight, reliable, and highly extensible subscription engine built specifically for WooCommerce. It enables digital creators, service providers, and physical stores to offer flexible subscription plans, generate recurring revenue, and manage subscription lifecycles effortlessly.

Designed to seamlessly integrate with your existing WooCommerce setup, YeeSubscriptions avoids complex database locks or heavy overhead. It utilizes custom order types to process subscription cycles, payment methods, and renewals while offering complete compatibility with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

Whether you are looking to offer simple monthly subscriptions, flexible global subscription plans, or custom trial periods to hook prospective customers, YeeSubscriptions provides a secure and clean foundation for your subscription business.

General Features

  • Custom Subscription Plans: Set up recurring billing per product or create reusable global plans that apply across multiple items.
  • Flexible Billing Intervals: Configure renewals on a daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly basis.
  • Free Trials: Drive acquisitions by offering trial periods with custom durations.
  • Customer Self-Service: Give subscribers full control to cancel, suspend, or reactivate their subscriptions directly from the standard WooCommerce My Account page.
  • Stripe & PayPal Compatibility: Fully compatible with popular WooCommerce payment gateways to process automated recurring payments safely.
  • WooCommerce Checkout Blocks Ready: Fully supports modern block-based Cart and Checkout flows.
  • High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS): Built-in support for HPOS ensures fast database queries and optimal server performance even with large databases.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the yeesubscriptions folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin directly through the WordPress plugins page.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure settings under WooCommerce > Settings > Subscriptions.
  4. To start selling, edit a product and configure subscription plans under the Subscription settings tab.
sections.faq:
Does YeeSubscriptions require custom payment gateways?

No. YeeSubscriptions is designed to integrate with major, standard WooCommerce payment gateways that support tokenization, such as WooCommerce PayPal Payments and WooCommerce Stripe.

Is YeeSubscriptions compatible with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)?

Yes! YeeSubscriptions declares full compatibility with HPOS to ensure your subscription data queried from the database remains extremely fast.

Can customers manage their subscriptions themselves?

Yes. Customers can suspend, cancel, and reactivate their subscriptions from the My Account > Subscriptions page.

Can I sell regular products and subscription products together?

YeeSubscriptions includes smart cart validation options to prevent or allow mixed carts (subscriptions and physical products) based on your store’s business rules and configuration settings.
